hook.name: VolatilityFeeHook
hook.description: Charges a volatility-scaled fee on every swap, ranging linearly between a base rate and a max rate (1%–5.3%) based on how far the previous swap moved the price in ticks. Fees are collected as ERC-6909 claims and swept to an immutable fee wallet via a permissionless sweep() function. Only exact-input swaps are supported.
